newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Spanish bank sets date for Colombia bank takeover.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bank sets date for Colombia bank takeover.

text.p: Santander Investment SA, a unit of Spain's Banco Santander SA, said Wednesday it would formally take a 55 percent stake in Colombia's Banco Santander Colombia, previously named Bancoquia, on July 21.

On that date, the Spanish institution will purchase 48.7 million shares at a price of 3,200 pesos per share through the Bogota stock exchange in a deal worth 155.9 billion pesos ($141.6 million at current exchange rates).
Santander Investment and Bancoquia's majority shareholder, the Santo Domingo conglomerate, signed an agreement in principle for the purchase in May.
With the sale of a 55 percent stake in the bank, the Santo Domingo group will retain a 26 percent stake in the bank.
